<title level="1" right="Action">[Aerial Retreat](/Actions.aspx?ID=2794) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 94

</column>

---

The hippogriff makes a talon Strike, then [Flies](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its fly Speed. The hippogriff and its rider gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.
